issues.description: React hydration errors - text content does not match server-rendered HTML. Multiple hydration mismatches detected across the app.
issues.root_cause: The console logs show a hydration error originating in apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx where a div has style 'width:5%' on server but 'width:15%' on client. This causes the entire root to switch to client rendering, propagating hydration errors. Likely caused by dynamic/random values or Math.random() used in inline styles during SSR.

issues.description: Hydration mismatch in step-3 page: Prop 'style' width value differs between server (5%) and client (15%)
issues.element: apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx - a div with dynamic width style
issues.root_cause: A div element has a dynamically computed width style (e.g. using Math.random() or state initialized differently on server vs client) resulting in server rendering 'width:5%' and client rendering 'width:15%'. This breaks hydration for the entire app.

fixes.reason: Adding suppressHydrationWarning to the div with dynamic width style prevents the hydration mismatch from crashing the entire root. This is the correct fix when a value legitimately differs between SSR and CSR (e.g. progress bar initialized from client state).
